title: Ahly S NDE 9175
content: NDE: I was 7 years old, and lived in a farm town in the interior of the Dominican Republic Somehow, I contracted and an invasive and aggressive Streptococcus infection that invaded my body. I got very ill and fainted. My father took me to the doctor, and I was transported immediately to Santo Domingo to be hospitalized. They place me in an oxygen chamber for six months, and gave me strong antibiotics because I was dying. They also sent a blood sample to Atlanta Georgia for diagnosis. I remember having an out of my body experience. I was in the clouds and some ANGELS took me to heaven. A huge man, dressed in White, ask me what I was doing there. I told him that I didn't know. He informed me that I couldn't be there. Then he took me by the hands and place me in the Top of a Huge Rainbow and push me downwards. I came down the rainbow, almost reaching earth. Then I saw my father worriedly talking to someone about me. Then I came down from the ceiling, into my body. The labratory in Atlanta identified the strain and I received the correct treatment. I felt much better and returned Home. --------------------------- Saturday, November 3, 2001 Probable NDE: I left my job and arrived home. I decided to put on new clothes and go for a test drive after installing a new engine. I went to the gas station to fill up the gas tank and get some food. And while I was at it, I bought a beer. Then I went bar hopping to the discos and at each one continued to drink. I remember someone telling me not to drive because I was drunk. I drove anyway. I didn't see the two vehicles that came from behind. I accelerated without looking and collided with a protective wall of a bridge. Everything turned black. I was in a beautiful place surrounded by stars. I had no pain, hunger, or anxiety. I only felt peace and comfort. I was surrounded by stars and could have stayed in that place forever. I remember looking at all the billions and billions of stars. I looked at myself and I was a star too. At that moment, I heard a soft voice telling me, 'It is not your time yet.' I remember feeling as if I had been thrown from a distance into my body. I woke up on a gurney in a hallway, to the stench of blood and terrible pains all over my body. A doctor was passing by me so I asked him to help me. They treated and stabilized me. My parents and some neighbors went to the hospital and found me. Later, they told me that at first they could not find me because I was not registered with my name, but under the name of 'Angel.' In one of the many surgeries I had, I had an anesthetic crisis and was dying. My body failed and I felt that I was dying. I saw an intense white light. I was making great efforts to breathe, then I remembered that if I died, I would surely reach the beautiful place full of stars. So I stopped fighting to breathe but the doctors saved my life. I breathed again and opened my eyes, frustrated because I could not die. This happened to me again in another surgery room, as I have had several major surgeries to be able to walk. During recovery, the accident left me greatly distressed. I had taken a great blow to the right frontal lobe in the accident. I needed to see a psychiatrist several times to the Psychiatrist because there were unsual things happening to me. I did not tell anyone, but I saw ghosts, I had extra-sensory experiences with elements of other dimensions. I saw lights that covered my bed and my room. At first it was very annoying and uncomfortable. These ghosts had elements that looked like shadows and others looked like flashes of light. Until I got used to my new reality, I heard voices within me. I also saw shadows and lights, in the form of corporeal, semi corporeal manifestations. I would talk to them and they would tell me very different and strange stories. I know very well that human life is more complex than what we know and that the human being has a component of spiritual make up, which is more complex than we know. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 3/11/2001 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Surgery-related. While under general anesthesia. Direct head injury. Out of body experience. Yes, Doctors say I could die of Fat embolism due to the severity of the trauma event How do you consider the content of your experience? Neither pleasant NOR distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes Stars and a sweet voice. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I somehow knew that I was near GOD, The infinite At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was DEAD Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. No sense of time. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I was Surrounded by Billions of stars and then thrown back to my body, filled with blood and pain. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. No sound. but a very comfortable sensation. then the voice saying It is not your turn yet. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes First a black space then a white bright one then full of billions of stars. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes STARS. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm a space with billions of stars. What emotions did you feel during the experience? none. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Yes. We are the Universe. Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I could stay there forever if were for me I'll be there now. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic I believe in the Holy Spirit Have your religious practices changed since your experience? I understand Christianism, and all mayor religions. Yes What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian I was Baptized Christian by choice, my current denomination is Adventist. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Well, God is not what people think it is. Everyone is connected to God. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I know life is a complex deal. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin A sweet voice telling me it was not my time. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Uncertain no relanve with the experience or my life. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes Yes. Humans are all connected to the eternal energy. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes The energy of all is God, God is a name to try to describe the totality. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists s Life is more complex than what we could think. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. Change is part of life, I've evolved and did change. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I was surrounded by Billions of bright stars and when I looked at myself, I was a star as well How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. This wWas a life changing event. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I cannot tell. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Yes. The sense of being right there as a part of the Universe. Being part of the complete scheme is very interesting and comfortable. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I shared long ago with people who looked at me in disbelief. But I do not care, so I share it here. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Uncertain My family and I traveled to India several times. I've known Goya, meditation and reincarnation since that time. I was not and I'm not a Believer now, I am a knower. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I had the car crash, and all the consequences of that including the NDE. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. Because it was real. I did not talk about it with My psychiatrist. Any way, they say I had post traumatic stress disorder PTSD. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: First NDE (age 7): "I was in the clouds" and later "came down from the ceiling, into my body." Second NDE (car crash): "I clearly left my body and existed outside it."

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Reported sequence: "First a black space then a white bright one then full of billions of stars."

arrival.other_being_detail: First NDE: "some ANGELS took me to heaven" and "A huge man, dressed in White" who said he couldn't be there and pushed him down a rainbow. Second NDE: a "soft voice" said, "It is not your time yet."

environment.environment_other_detail: Second NDE: "a beautiful place surrounded by stars" with "billions and billions of stars"; he reports "I was a star too." First NDE includes "heaven" and being placed "in the Top of a Huge Rainbow."

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Second NDE: "feeling as if I had been thrown from a distance into my body." First NDE: pushed down a rainbow and then "came down from the ceiling, into my body."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car crash into a bridge wall while drunk (primary reported NDE date 3/11/2001). Narrative also includes a childhood life-threatening illness (streptococcus infection) with an OBE and later anesthesia crises during surgeries.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Prior: Catholic. After: Adventist ("Baptized Christian by choice").

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also includes angels/"huge man dressed in White" and a star-filled realm; later reports intense white light during anesthesia crisis.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Second NDE described: blackness/black space → white bright space → star-filled realm → voice says "It is not your time yet" → thrown back into body. First NDE: OBE in clouds → angels to heaven → encounter with huge man in white → pushed down rainbow → sees father → returns to body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple NDE-like episodes: childhood illness OBE; car crash NDE; anesthesia crises with white light and near-dying sensations.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Self-identification as a star in a star-filled realm; return via being pushed down a huge rainbow; later reported being registered at the hospital under the name "Angel."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "It is not your time yet." / "I looked at myself and I was a star too." / "Then he took me by the hands and place me in the Top of a Huge Rainbow and push me downwards."
